name: tstack
description: If you want to go fast, go deep first — without burning your weekly budget. tstack is a token-frugal fork of pstack: it never spawns subagents. One session does the work, reading only the lines it needs; when you want more hands, it messages the Claude sessions you already opened (lanes) instead of creating new ones. Same rigorous workflows, a fraction of the tokens. Forked from michael-denyer/pstack-claude. Original pstack by Lauren Tan (tstack).

interface.shortDescription: Rigorous, parallelizable agent workflows: go deep first, write less, verify everything
interface.longDescription: tstack guides agent work through solo's principles, design exploration (architect), adversarial multi-model review (interrogate), root-cause debugging, prose deslopping, and verified delivery. Skills are shared with the Claude Code build; on Codex, tool names resolve via the codex-tools mapping.
interface.developerName: Michael Denyer (port of Lauren Tan's pstack)
defaultPrompt: Interrogate this diff with multiple models.
